On October 5, 2026, The Marzetti Company (the “Company”) announced that Tanya Berman, President of Retail Division of T. Marzetti Company, a subsidiary of the Company, is no longer serving in this role effective October 6, 2026. The Company expects that Ms. Berman will remain an employee of the Company until December 31, 2026. The Company expects to enter into a severance agreement with Ms. Berman in connection with her separation from the Company. The details of the severance agreement have not been determined at this time. The Company will provide a description of such severance agreement in a future filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission following its execution.
